findings.evidence: Both proofs contain `∑ … |B i|` followed by `(le_abs_self _).trans (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)))`.
findings.fix: Use one existing finite-upper-bound fact, e.g. `(Set.finite_Iic ℓ).bddAbove` on the image of `B`, or `Finset.sup'`. Otherwise factor the argument into a single helper used by both proofs.
findings.issue: `exists_forall_norm_iteratedFDeriv_le` and `TendstoUniformlyOn.exists_forall_norm_le_of_isCompact` (Bounded.lean) both repeat the same argument: combine finitely many bounds by summing `|B i|` over `Finset.range` and applying `Finset.single_le_sum`.

summary: The proofs are of reasonable length and mostly robust, but they contain an undocumented `change` and two no-op `rw [show … from rfl]` steps that rely on definitional equality. The same finite-bound summing argument also appears twice.
